entities.summary: Harjavalta is a town and municipality in Finland. It's located in the Satakunta region, 29 kilometres (18 mi) southeast of Pori. The town has a population of 6,572 and covers an area of 127.74 square kilometres (49.32 sq mi) of which 4.28 km2 (1.65 sq mi) is water. The population density is 53.22 inhabitants per square kilometre (137.8/sq mi). Harjavalta is a town in Northern Europe, established around 1869. A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
